_comment: Battery capacity (Wh) by Jackery cloud model_code. PR additions here when you discover a new model_code — see CONTRIBUTING for how to identify yours. Loaded by forecaster.py at startup; runtime per-device overrides via the Device tab still take priority over this catalog.
